work.summary: Led progressive career path from Assistant Engineer to Senior Manager, overseeing cross-functional teams in supply chain, procurement, and product development.
highlights: Directed large-scale supply chain operations with focus on risk management, cost optimization, and strategic procurement
Implemented data-driven demand forecasting models (ARIMA, ML-based approaches), reducing forecasting error variance by 15%
Negotiated supplier contracts and optimized procurement strategy, achieving up to 8-10% cost savings annually
Led quality improvement initiative using Root Cause Analysis (RCA), reducing defect rates to below 0.2%
Supervised teams of up to 20 professionals
